name: Collver Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single residence with a dark roof and an irregular footprint, plus a smaller detached structure|A paved driveway leads from the street to the front of the house|Mature trees cover much of the lot, with open dirt and sparse vegetation on the upper portion|A green lawn sits near the street frontage|Neighboring developed lots and open land are visible around the parcel.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence faces the street, with a paved driveway and a green lawn between the road and the house|The house has a dark multi-gable roof and light-colored walls|Dense mature trees stand behind and to the sides of the structure|A smaller outbuilding is visible through the trees in the background.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows dense mature trees surrounding and covering most of the view of the structures, with open dirt ground and sparse vegetation beyond the tree line|The driveway and a portion of the house are partially visible through the trees|A paved or gravel drive encircles the patch of dense trees and runs along to the main driveway|No clear side yard or open path is visible along this edge.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows a detached structure with a light roof, dense mature trees, and open dirt ground extending beyond the trees|The main house is partially visible through the vegetation|A paved or gravel path moves from the house around the dense patch of trees toward the other side of the main residence|No open rear yard is clearly defined.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the house with a dark roof, a paved driveway, and a green lawn near the street|Dense mature trees stand close to the structure|A detached building and fenced garden area sit behind the house|Open dirt ground extends beyond the trees.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway from Glen Vista Rd to the front of the house. The site is a single-family residence on a wooded lot with dense mature trees surrounding the structure on multiple sides. Tree cover may limit sightlines and movement around the sides and rear. A detached structure is present. A paved/gravel drive encircles the immediate property, running behind the trees that surround the house. No gates are visible on the driveway from the imagery. Neighboring homes and open land sit on adjacent parcels.
clarifications: Is the driveway a through route or does it terminate at the front of the house? Are there any gates or fences controlling access to the property or the detached structure? Is there a usable path around the house through the trees for pedestrian or equipment movement? What is the purpose of the detached structure? Are there additional entries on the rear or sides that are not clearly visible?
